parsed.title: Inconsistent hand-off target
parsed.detail: The 'Done when' section states the hand-off is '/review-plan <unit>', but the 'Append contract' section (line 56) states the write 'hands off to /review-plan — never straight to /execute-phase'. While both point to /review-plan, the 'Append contract' implies a hand-off to a process, whereas the 'Done when' section describes the hand-off as a specific command. More critically, the 'Hand-off' section in the reference file (PHASE_APPEND.md) provides a specific text template for the hand-off that includes a 'Next:' line, which is not explicitly required or described in the main SKILL.md 'Done when' checklist.
